licence.leaseMustBeValidToRenew.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Gold and Diamond Park, lease (official Jafza pages: the lease must be valid to renew the licence; Jafza handles all licensing for Gold and Diamond Park (Jafza news, 2 Sep 2020), CONFIRMED); https://www.jafza.ae/resource-centre/guides/lease-renewal/ ; https://www.jafza.ae/resource-centre/media/news/jafza-signs-agreement-with-emaar-malls-to-extend-its-expertise-beyond-jebel-ali/

licence.leaseMinRemainingDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Gold and Diamond Park, lease (no minimum remaining period stated; a three year licence renewal is allowed only where the plot or sublease has more than three years of validity); https://www.jafza.ae/resource-centre/guides/lease-renewal/

licence.renewalWindow.value: A licence can be renewed within three months before expiry.
licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Gold and Diamond Park, renewal window (official Jafza renew licence page, CONFIRMED; Jafza handles licensing for Gold and Diamond Park); https://www.jafza.ae/resource-centre/guides/renew-license/ ; https://www.jafza.ae/resource-centre/media/news/jafza-signs-agreement-with-emaar-malls-to-extend-its-expertise-beyond-jebel-ali/

licence.renewsTogether.value: An NOC from the Gold and Diamond Park Authority at renewal. Jafza lease renewal needs rent payment confirmation and updated workmen's compensation, third party and fire insurance copies.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Gold and Diamond Park, renews together (official Jafza renew licence and lease renewal pages, CONFIRMED. REPORTED only: consultancies say renewal includes the establishment card); https://www.jafza.ae/resource-centre/guides/renew-license/ ; https://www.jafza.ae/resource-centre/guides/lease-renewal/

licence.afterExpiry.value: A late payment fee applies to an expired licence on a monthly basis. Jafza offers a reinstatement service for customers whose registration was terminated by the Jafza Authority. No grace period or day threshold for suspension or termination was found.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Gold and Diamond Park, late renewal (Jafza Rules 9th edition tariff, renew licence page and reinstatement guide, CONFIRMED; amounts left out. Not verified, REPORTED only: a consultancy (relocate-uae) claims cancellation if not renewed within 4 months); https://www.jafza.ae/resource-centre/downloads/jafza-rules-regulations ; https://www.jafza.ae/resource-centre/guides/renew-license/ ; https://www.jafza.ae/resources/guides/registration-and-license-reinstatement/
